加载包
```{r setup, include=FALSE}
knitr::opts_chunk$set(echo = TRUE)
library(ggplot2)
library(readxl)
library(dplyr)
library(tidyr)
```

##加载数据及处理
我们发现疾病中只有一例鳞癌，此外全为腺癌，所以我将鳞癌直接摘除数据之外
```{r}
mdata <- read_xlsx("./clean.metadata.xlsx","Sheet1")
summary(mdata)
table(mdata$Disease)
mdata_clean <- mdata%>%
  filter(Disease!="鳞癌")
table(mdata_clean$Disease)

```
##观察EGFR突变类型及病情发展情况
```{r}
table(mdata_clean$EGFR)
mdata_clean$EGFR[which(mdata_clean$EGFR=="19del")] <- "19Del"
mdata_clean$Dev_factor <- as.factor(mdata_clean$Develop)
levels(mdata_clean$Dev_factor) <- c("未恶化","恶化")
table(mdata_clean$Dev_factor)
mutation_data<-data.frame(num=seq(from=1,to=65,by=1),mdata_clean$EGFR,mdata_clean$Dev_factor)
show(mutation_data)
```
##创建统计图
```{r}
result_table<-mutation_data%>%
  group_by(mdata_clean.EGFR,mdata_clean.Dev_factor)%>%
  summarise(count=n(),.groups="drop")%>%
  pivot_wider(names_from=mdata_clean.Dev_factor,values_from=count,values_fill=0)
print(result_table)
plot_data <- result_table %>%
  pivot_longer(
    cols = c("未恶化", "恶化"),
    names_to = "Dev_status",
    values_to = "count"
  )
```
##绘图
```{r}
ggplot(plot_data, aes(x = mdata_clean.EGFR, y = count, fill = Dev_status)) +
  geom_bar(stat = "identity", position = position_dodge()) +
  geom_text(aes(label = count), 
            position = position_dodge(width = 0.9),
            vjust = -0.5, size = 2) +
  labs(title = "EGFR突变类型与疾病发展关系",
       x = "EGFR突变类型",
       y = "患者数量",
       fill = "疾病状态") +
  scale_fill_manual(values = c("未恶化" = "green", "恶化" = "red"))
```

```{r}
# 首先筛选出19Del和L858R的数据
filtered_data <- mutation_data %>%
  filter(mdata_clean.EGFR %in% c("19Del", "L858R"))

# 计算比例（按突变类型分组）
plot_data <- filtered_data %>%
  group_by(mdata_clean.EGFR) %>%
  count(mdata_clean.Dev_factor) %>%
  mutate(prop = n / sum(n)) %>%
  ungroup()

# 绘制比例堆叠图（仅显示19Del和L858R）
ggplot(plot_data, aes(x = mdata_clean.EGFR, y = prop, fill = mdata_clean.Dev_factor)) +
  geom_bar(stat = "identity") +
  geom_text(aes(label = scales::percent(prop, accuracy = 1)), 
            position = position_stack(vjust = 0.5),
            color = "white", size = 4) +
  labs(title = "19Del与L858R突变类型的恶化比例",
       x = "突变类型",
       y = "比例",
       fill = "疾病状态") +
  scale_fill_manual(values = c("未恶化" = "green", "恶化" = "red")) +
  scale_y_continuous(labels = scales::percent) +
  theme_minimal() +
  theme(legend.position = "top")
```
##显著性检验
```{r}
test_data <- filtered_data %>%
  select(mdata_clean.EGFR, mdata_clean.Dev_factor)
fisher_result <- fisher.test(table(test_data))
print(fisher_result)
```
